# TASK-175 — specification

## Scope

Publish SDD Studio to Spec-Driven-Helper with a shared website and MCP Apps specification visualizer, bounded recorded relationships and progress, and an evidence-based improvement prompt using human-reviewed, revision-aware proposals.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Publish the existing workspace to `antoinebou12/Spec-Driven-Helper`, preserving its initial license and history.
- [ ] Expose the same interactive specification progress and recorded relationships in Overview and an authenticated MCP Apps resource.
- [ ] Page large responses, retain plain structured content for other clients, and never embed secrets or project data in the HTML.
- [ ] Explicit improvement requests go to the assistant conversation; suggestions remain proposals.
- [ ] Accept a source revision on proposals and refuse stale snapshots.
- [ ] Keep bilingual controls, keyboard access, local-only confirmation, project permissions and the MCP feature gate.
- [ ] Verify protocol contracts, browser interactions, accessibility and existing checks; document the running-server requirement separately from source publication.
